title: DualTrack: Synchronized speech-gesture generation via symmetric coupling of pretrained priors
abstract: arXiv:2609.36624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Joint speech-gesture synthesis must coordinate two modalities despite limited paired data. Existing approaches often lack bidirectional interaction, have limited language coverage, or simplify body and finger representations. We present DualTrack, which couples pretrained speech and motion priors on a shared 12.5 Hz timeline. Causal adapters exchange previous-packet information, while current-state fusion coordinates the streams before they separately complete sixteen-codebook packets. We evaluate 43 BEAT2 recordings in four languages, with speakers held out from joint training and validation. On the shared English/Spanish inputs, without speech or motion prefixes, DualTrack achieves lower word error rate and full-motion Fr\'echet Gesture Distance, higher beat consistency and speech naturalness than the evaluated GELINA baseline.

translated_title: DualTrack：通过对称耦合预训练先验实现同步的语音-手势生成
translated_abstract: 联合语音-手势合成需要在配对数据有限的情况下协调两种模态。现有方法往往缺乏双向交互、语言覆盖有限，或简化了身体和手指的表示。我们提出了DualTrack，它在共享的12.5 Hz时间线上耦合预训练的语音和运动先验。因果适配器交换先前数据包的信息，而当前状态融合在两个流分别完成十六码本数据包之前协调这些流。我们在四种语言的43条BEAT2录音上进行评估，说话人在联合训练和验证中被分离保留。在共享的英语/西班牙语输入上，在无语音或运动前缀的情况下，DualTrack相比所评估的GELINA基线实现了更低的词错误率和全身运动Fréchet手势距离，以及更高的节拍一致性和语音自然度。
tldr: DualTrack通过在共享12.5 Hz时间线上对称耦合预训练语音与运动先验，利用因果适配器与当前状态融合实现双向交互，在四种语言上生成同步的语音-手势，并超越GELINA基线。
en_tdlr: DualTrack achieves synchronized speech-gesture generation across four languages by symmetrically coupling pretrained speech and motion priors with bidirectional causal adapters and state fusion, outperforming the GELINA baseline.
